question: In a certain code language, 'FIRST' is written as 'TSRIF'. How will 'NOSTALGIC' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a08c777a36f898d492c29ef3a13c1a9aad5b988568e613e5a9282d9466dd8871.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Letters are written from right end to left end.

 
• FIRST → TSRIF 

Similarly,

 
• NOSTALGIC → CIGLATSON

Hence, '**CIGLATSON**' is the correct answer.
